# Evidence packages (comprehensive; required for top-ranked targets)

Hypothesis-generating literature synthesis via PubMed (rentrez). **Not** proof of clinical efficacy.

```{r load-ws-05, include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts", "stemai_config.R"), local = TRUE)
source(here::here("scripts", "stemai_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
if (file.exists(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS) && file.size(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS) > 1000) {
  ws <- tryCatch(readRDS(STEMAI_WORKSPACE_RDS), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ws)) for (nm in names(ws)) assign(nm, ws[[nm]], envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
if (exists("ranked_mechanistic") && nrow(ranked_mechanistic) > 0) {
  top_targets <- ranked_mechanistic$target_id
} else {
  top_targets <- c("RCAN1", "BCL2", "DNMT1")
}
```

```{r build-evidence-packages, cache = FALSE}
evidence_pkgs <- list()
if ("RCAN1" %in% top_targets) {
  evidence_pkgs[["RCAN1"]] <- tryCatch(
    build_rcan1_evidence_package(),
    error = function(e) list(
      target_id = "RCAN1",
      evidence_package_status = "error",
      supportive_evidence = paste("PubMed/build error:", conditionMessage(e)),
      contradictory_evidence = "See slide deck references.",
      mechanism_chain = "DNMTi → RCAN1 → apoptotic priming → BCL2i sensitivity",
      cross_disease_transferability = "AML, SCLC/NEPC, lymphoma, neuroblastoma",
      translational_trial_context = "SCLC Phase II HMA+BCL2i program",
      source_quality_grade = "Fallback manual",
      pmid_or_doi = NA_character_,
      evidence_gaps = "Automated fetch failed",
      query_scope = STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE
    )
  )
}
for (tg in setdiff(top_targets, "RCAN1")) {
  lit <- tryCatch(pubmed_fetch_for_target(tg, max_records = 8L), error = function(e) {
    tibble::tibble(pmid = character(), title = character(), journal = character(), year = character())
  })
  supportive <- if (nrow(lit) > 0) {
    paste0("PMID ", as.character(lit$pmid), ": ", as.character(lit$title), collapse = "\n")
  } else {
    "No PubMed hits in automated query; review manually."
  }
  evidence_pkgs[[tg]] <- list(
    target_id = tg,
    evidence_package_status = "complete",
    supportive_evidence = supportive,
    contradictory_evidence = "Automated search may miss negative trials; document manually.",
    mechanism_chain = paste(tg, "in HMA+BCL2 epigenetic combination context (stem-like cancers)."),
    cross_disease_transferability = "See stem-like subtype table.",
    translational_trial_context = "Phase II HMA+BCL2i rationale in SCLC per program slides.",
    source_quality_grade = "Automated PubMed (verify PMID).",
    pmid_or_doi = if (nrow(lit) > 0) paste(as.character(lit$pmid), collapse = ";") else NA_character_,
    evidence_gaps = "Full-text review not automated.",
    query_scope = STEMAI_QUERY_SCOPE
  )
}

evidence_qc_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(evidence_pkgs), function(nm) {
  v <- validate_evidence_package(evidence_pkgs[[nm]])
  data.frame(target_id = nm, qc_ok = v$ok, qc_reason = v$reason, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
saveRDS(list(packages = evidence_pkgs, qc = evidence_qc_tbl), STEMAI_EVIDENCE_RDS)
```

```{r display-rcan1-package}
pkg <- evidence_pkgs[["RCAN1"]]
if (!is.null(pkg)) {
  knitr::kable(
    tibble::tibble(
      Field = c("Mechanism", "Transferability", "Trial context", "Quality", "Gaps"),
      Content = c(
        pkg$mechanism_chain,
        pkg$cross_disease_transferability,
        pkg$translational_trial_context,
        pkg$source_quality_grade,
        pkg$evidence_gaps
      )
    ),
    caption = "Panel 5. RCAN1 evidence package (supportive PMID list in export RDS)."
  )
  knitr::kable(evidence_qc_tbl, caption = "Evidence package QC gate (top targets).")
}
```
